content.hebrew: אַתָּה נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתִי; אַל תִּירָא, אֲנִי עֲזַרְתִּֽיךָ.
content.transliteration: Atta ne’eman beti; al tira, ani ‘azartikha.
content.english: “You are the faithful one of My house; fear not, for I have helped you.
content.comments: You are. This is God’s speech to Moses (up to line 10).

content.hebrew: אֲנִי יוי קְרָאתִֽיךָ בְצֶֽדֶק, וּבִימִינִי תְמַכְתִּֽיךָ.
content.transliteration: Ani Adonai ḳeratikha vetsedeḳ, uvimini temakhtikha.
content.english: I, Adonai, have called you to do righteousness, and have supported you with My right hand.

content.hebrew: בְּטֶֽרֶם אֶצָּרְךָ בַבֶּֽטֶן יְדַעְתִּֽיךָ,
content.transliteration: Beterem ets’tsorkha vabbeten yeda‘tikha,
content.english: When I had not yet formed you in the belly, I knew you,

content.hebrew: קהל: וּבְטֶֽרֶם תֵּצֵא מֵרֶֽחֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּֽיךָ, נָבִיא לַגּוֹיִם נְתַתִּֽיךָ.  (ירמיהו א:ה)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Uvterem tetsē mereḥem hiḳdashtikha, navi laggoyim netattikha.
content.english: Cong. And when you had not yet left the womb, I consecrated you, and made you a prophet for the nations.      (Jer. 1:5)

content.hebrew: הַשְׁכֵּם וּבֹא אֶל חָפְרַע אֲשֶׁר מִלִּין הִגְבִּיר.
content.transliteration: Hashkem uvo el hofra‘ asher millin hiḡbir.
content.english: “Rise early, and go to Hofra‘, who has spoken excessively.

content.hebrew: הִכְבַּדְתִּי אֶת־לִבּוֹ וְלֵב עֲבָדָיו כַּבִּיר,
content.transliteration: Hikhbadti et libbo velev ‘avadav kabbir,
content.english: I have made his heart heavy, and the heart of his servants, which is excessively inflated,

content.hebrew: לְמַֽעַן שִׁתִי אֹתֹתַי אֵֽלֶּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ – הֲתֻלִים מַחְבִּיר.
content.transliteration: Lema‘an shiti ototai ellē beḳirbo – hatulim maḥbir.
content.english: In order to place these miracles of Mine in his midst—[for] he composes taunts.

content.hebrew: קהל: הֶֽבֶל יִפְצֶה פִֽיהוּ, בִּבְלִי דַֽעַת מִלִּין יַ[כְ]בִּיר.   (איוב לה:טז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Hevel yiftsē fihu, bivli da‘at millin yakhbir.
content.english: Cong. His mouth speaks  folly; he mindlessly spews words. (Job 35:16)

content.hebrew: רְבוֹת מוֹפְתַי בּוֹ, הִקְשֵֽׁיתִי אֶת־לִבּוֹ,
content.transliteration: Revot mofetai bo, hiḳsheti et libbo,
content.english: “To multiply My wonders against him, I have hardened his heart,

content.hebrew: עֲדֵי יִלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְמַדּוֹ, וְתָבוֹא כַמַּֽיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ.
content.transliteration: ‘adē yilbash ḳelala khemaddo, vetavo khammayim beḳirbo.
content.english: Until he wears a curse as his garment, and it enters him like water.”

content.hebrew: בְּנֶֽגַע עֲשִׂירִי יְבַעֲתוֹ; קָדַם וְהִתְרָהוּ עוֹדֶֽנוּ בְאִבּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Beneḡa‘ ‘asiri yeva‘ato; ḳadam vehitrahu ‘odenu ve’ibbo:
content.english: [God] intimidated [Pharaoh] with the tenth plague; He first warned him, when he was still very green:
content.comments: [God] intimidated [Pharaoh]. Here begins the narration, after the conclusion of God’s speech to Moses.

content.hebrew: קהל: וּמַלְאָךְ אַכְזָרִי יְשֻׁלַּח בּוֹ.      (משלי יז:יא)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Umalakh akhzari yeshullaḥ bo.
content.english: Cong. [That] a cruel angel would be dispatched against him.  (Prov. 17:11)

content.hebrew: נִיסָן בְּנִסִּים נוֹרָאִים וּפְלָאִים מְחֻדָּשִׁים
content.transliteration: Nisan benissim nora’im ufla’im meḥuddashim
content.english: Nisan, with awesome miracles and newly made wonders,

content.hebrew: מְשַׂמֵּֽחַ בְּיָמָיו אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים.
content.transliteration: Mesamme’aḥ beyamav Elohim va’anashim.
content.english: Makes God and people happy in its days.

content.hebrew: צִוָּה יוי לְזֶֽרַע יְשֻׁרוּן, עַם קְדֹשִׁים:
content.transliteration: Tsivva Adonai lezera‘ Yeshurun, ‘am ḳedoshim:
content.english: Adonai commanded the progeny of Jeshurun, the nation of holy people:

content.hebrew: קהל: הַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לָכֶם רֹאשׁ חֳדָשִׁים.     (שמות יב:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Haḥodesh hazzē lakhem rosh ḥodashim.
content.english: Cong. This month shall be for you the first of months.   (Exod. 12:2)

content.hebrew: אוֹצַר לוּדִים בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁאוֹל מָלֹךְ,
content.transliteration: Otsar ludim betset Yisra’el lish’ol malokh,
content.english: When Israel left, they decided to ask for the riches of the Lydians;

content.hebrew: כֶּֽסֶף וְזָהָב וּבִגְדֵי רִקְמָה לָקַח – וַיֵּֽלֶךְ הָלֹךְ.
content.transliteration: Kesef vezahav uviḡdē riḳma laḳaḥ – vayyelekh halokh.
content.english: Silver and gold and embroidered garments they took and went on their way.

content.hebrew: נָשָׂא אֶת־בְּצֵקוֹ בְּשִׂמְחָה לַהֲלֹךְ,
content.transliteration: Nassa et betseḳo besimḥa lahalokh,
content.english: They carried their dough gaily, as they walked,

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי מִבֵּית הַסּוּרִים יָצָא לִמְלֹךְ.     (קהלת ד:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki mibbet hassurim yatsa limlokh.
content.english: Cong. For they were leaving prison to be kings! (Eccl. 4:14)

content.hebrew: לֵיל בּוֹ נָסַע – בְּאֹתוֹ לֵיל כָּרַת יוי בְּרִיתָם;
content.transliteration: Lel bo nasa‘ – be’oto lel karat Adaony beritam;
content.english: On the night they traveled—that very same night—Adonai had made a covenant with them;

content.hebrew: עוֹד הוּא קָבֽוּעַ וְשָׁמוּר לְחֵרוּתָם,
content.transliteration: ‘od hu ḳavu’a‘ veshamur leḥerutam,
content.english: [The night] is still established and preserved for their freedom,

content.hebrew: שִׁמֻּרִים לְכָל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְדֹרֹתָם –
content.transliteration: Shimmurim lekhol benē Yisra’el ledorotam –
content.english: Protection for the Israelites, for all their generations—

content.hebrew: קהל: הָרֹפֵא לִשְׁבֽוּרֵי לֵב וּמְחַבֵּשׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָם.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Harofē lishvurē lev umḥabbesh le‘ats’tsevotam.
content.english: Cong. [He] heals the brokenhearted, and bandages their sorrow. (Ps. 147:3)

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּ֛י נַ֥עַר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וָאֹֽהֲבֵ֑הוּ וּמִמִּצְרַ֖יִם קָרָ֥אתִי לִבְנִֽי: (הושע יא:א)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki na‘ar Yisra’el va’ohavehu umimMitsrayim ḳarati livni:
content.english: Cantor. For Israel is a child, and I have loved him; and I called my son out of Egypt. (Hos. 11:1)

content.hebrew: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יו֖י עַמּ֑וֹ יַֽעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַֽחֲלָתֽוֹ: (דברים לב:ט)
content.transliteration: Ki ḥeleḳ Adonai ‘ammo Ya‘aḳov ḥevel naḥalato:
content.english: For Adonai is His people’s lot; Jacob is the portion of His inheritance. (Deut. 32:9)

content.hebrew: כִּֽי־יַֽעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ: (תהלים קלה:ד)
content.transliteration: Ki Ya‘aḳov baḥar lo Yah Yisrae’el lisḡullato:
content.english: For Yah has chosen Jacob, Israel for His treasured [people]. (Ps. 135:4)

content.hebrew: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹֽרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַֽחֲרֽוֹן: (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Hear me, Jacob, and Israel, who are called by Me: I am He, I am the first, and I am also the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai Elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
